Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, I ask You, for You are the Sovereign
And You have power over all things

Arabic text: وَأَنَّكَ مَا تَشَاءُ مِنْ أَمْرٍ يَكُونُ
Translation: And whatever matter You will, it comes to be

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, I turn to You through Your Prophet Muhammad

Arabic text: نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: The Prophet of mercy, may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family

Arabic text: إِنِّيْ أَتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إِلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّكَ وَرَبِّي
Translation: I turn through you to Allah, your Lord and my Lord
That He may fulfill my request through you
O Allah, through Your Prophet Muhammad
And the Imams from his household
May Allah's blessings be upon him and upon them
